world.title: Canada braces for prolonged trade war as counter-tariffs on US take effect
world.description: The tariffs will apply to $20bn worth of American products, jeopardising the stability of the world's largest bilateral trading relationship.

world.title: At least two people dead after Russian strikes on Kyiv
world.description: Air raid alerts and sounds of explosions rang out in Ukraine's capital as Russian forces launched drone strikes early on Tuesday.

world.title: Investigation after female staff at Eiffel Tower replaced by men for religious visit
world.description: The move saw outraged staff walk off the job on Monday, closing the French landmark for a day.

world.title: Highest paid world leader to get salary increase of $1 million
world.description: Singapore's prime minister Lawrence Wong will see his annual pay rise to 3.6 million Singapore dollars ($2.8m; £2.1m).

world.title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
world.description: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.

world.title: Five killed in Miami plane crash were in two vehicles on ground, investigators say
world.description: Investigators described the scene as "utter devastation" after a Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami airport.

world.title: Trial over killing of Australian surfer brothers and US friend starts in Mexico
world.description: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their US friend Carter Rhoad were found at the bottom of a well with gunshot wounds.

world.title: Nepal cracks down on online abuse of flood survivors
world.description: Authorities will "show no leniency" to people who "belittle" those who are suffering, the prime minister says.

world.title: North Korea and Russia open first road bridge linking both countries
world.description: Relations between the neighbours have strengthened since the start of the Ukraine war.

world.title: Kenya moves to register frightened Burundians as tension over foreign traders rises
world.description: All foreigners without proper documents in Kenya are urged to  register through their embassies.

world.title: Trump threatens to stop sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US
world.description: The threat against one of Canada's largest companies comes amid an escalating trade war between the two neighbours.

world.title: Ukraine's chief prosecutor resigns over call centre corruption scandal
world.description: In his resignation letter, Ruslan Kravchenko denied the allegations against him, saying he did not want his office "to be used as a tool in political confrontation".

world.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
world.description: The far-right party is trying to form a government in the state after falling three seats short of a majority.

world.title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of  'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
world.description: Mladić was jailed for genocide during the 1990s Bosnian war and the EU warned Serbia not to glorify the convicted war criminal.

world.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill 12
world.description: Lebanon says a recent Israeli escalation is jeopardising a US-brokered ceasefire meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

US.title: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
US.description: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight.

US.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
US.description: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to

US.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
US.description: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

US.title: 60 years later, 'Star Trek' continues to 'live long and prosper'
US.description: The television series, Star Trek, turns 60 on Tuesday. The original show aired for only three seasons, but it spawned prequels and sequels (on TV and in theaters) and still has a cult following.

US.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
US.description: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

US.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
US.description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

US.title: King Charles III clarifies status of Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan
US.description: King Charles III has reiterated that Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, remain non-working members of the royal family following their return to the United Kingdom.

US.title: Russia and North Korea open the first road across their shared border
US.description: Relations between Russia and North Korea have been flourishing, with North Korea supplying ammunition and troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine in return for economic and military assist

US.title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
US.description: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.

US.title: 5 dead after crash at Miami Airport. And, Germany's far-right wins state election
US.description: A cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport has left five people dead and several others injured. And, Germany's far-right AfD party achieves an electoral victory in a key state election.
